verdicts.title: Study on the Resolution of Large-Eddy Simulations for Supersonic Jet Flows
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The present study is concerned with large-eddy simulations (LES) of supersonic jet flows. The work addresses, in particular, the simulation of a perfectly expanded free jet flow with an exit Mach number of 1.4 and an exit temperature equal to the ambient temperature. verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The results of Direct Numerical Simulations of the oscillatory flow over a cohesionless bed of spherical particles, mimicking sediment grains, are described.
